scope: Deterministic grading authority distilled from Broadcom compatibility, interoperability, VCF 9.0 sizing, vSAN ReadyNode, and VCF 5.x upgrade publications current on the snapshot date.

gateCatalog.upgrade-bundle-staged: The target bundle is downloaded and the component precheck passes.
gateCatalog.aria-lifecycle-818: Aria Suite Lifecycle is at 8.18 before the operations transition.
gateCatalog.operations-9-ready: VCF Operations 9.0 is online before the core management-domain upgrade.
gateCatalog.sddc-manager-9-complete: SDDC Manager is at 9.0 before NSX is upgraded.
gateCatalog.nsx-9-complete: NSX is at 9.0 before vCenter is upgraded.
gateCatalog.vcenter-9-complete: vCenter is at 9.0 and reduced-downtime upgrade checks have passed before ESXi remediation.
gateCatalog.vlcm-image-managed: The cluster is managed by a vSphere Lifecycle Manager image rather than baselines.
gateCatalog.esxi-9-complete: Every management-cluster ESXi host is at 9.0 before the storage migration.
gateCatalog.esa-readynode-hardware: The destination hosts and NVMe devices are certified for vSAN ESA at the target release.
gateCatalog.migration-capacity: The new ESA cluster has enough protected free capacity to evacuate the OSA datastore.
gateCatalog.storage-migration-complete: All data is migrated and policy compliance is healthy before the distributed-switch version is advanced.
gateCatalog.management-vmk-on-vds: Management, vMotion, and vSAN VMkernel adapters are on a distributed switch.
